## About
John Goehle, MBA, CASC is an ambulatory surgery center advisor, author of eight ASC books plus a personal memoir, and host of The ASC Podcast. Related sites: jgoehle.com, johngoehle.com, ascpodcast.com, ah-strategies.com, egd-consulting.com, goehle.net.
